[1/2] Graphics cycle: tint the viewmodel with per-weapon overdrive materials while the timer runs, with a staged pair and overdrive drill

impact_assessment.why: Overdrive is a prominent 8 s x2 state, but only the HUD line changes; the held weapon looks identical, so the active power-up lacks a visual state.
impact_assessment.benefits: The gun glows with a brighter per-weapon overdrive material while the timer runs and reverts automatically, using existing nodes and no new draws.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: material selection only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, timer, damage or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first material-state tests, a staged overdrive pair at 960x540, an overdrive drill hash parity and the full gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Overdrive glow proven: 248 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 5338 px gun-only pair, same overdrive hash 7c1080ce, t 7.83; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-77-overdrive-glow' completed successfully.
[1/2] Audio cycle: map the clutch wave-clear event to a distinct voice and CLUTCH CLEAR caption, with a low-HP pair, WAV and clutch drill

impact_assessment.why: The sim emits clutch on a wave clear at 30 HP or less, but the game ignores it; only the generic wave cue plays, so a notable survival moment is unannounced.
impact_assessment.benefits: A distinct chime and CLUTCH CLEAR caption mark the low-health clear while the wave completion voice still plays.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: event/audio/caption only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, score, HP or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first clutch/normal-clear tests, a low-HP caption pair, a clutch drill and a WAV/spectrogram probe.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Clutch cue proven: 251 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 1260 px pair, same clear hash ae293bcd, audio 1->2; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-78-clutch-cue' completed successfully.
[1/2] Progression cycle: clear the debrief save warning after a later successful profile write, keeping the lifetime error counter, with a retry pair and save_retry drill

impact_assessment.why: profile_save_errors is a lifetime counter; one transient locked save leaves PROFILE NOT SAVED on every later debrief even after a successful save, falsely implying current progress is unsaved.
impact_assessment.benefits: A separate last-outcome flag makes the warning truthful while preserving the error count for telemetry.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: save status + debrief draw; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: profile schema, atomic writes and error counter unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first failed-then-success test, a retry capture pair at 960x540, a save_retry drill and the full gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Stale warning cleared: 253 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 13360 px retry pair, same hash 99f337e7, errors 1/failed false; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-79-save-retry' completed successfully.
[1/2] Combat-feel cycle: pulse the low-health edge warning with sim time, with a low-HP pair and clutch-drill parity

impact_assessment.why: The <=30 HP warning is a static red edge, so critical health has no urgency or motion; it can fade into the scene.
impact_assessment.benefits: A deterministic sine pulse raises and lowers the warning alpha, making critical health readable without changing HP, damage or save state.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HUD draw only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, HP, camera or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first pulse/off-state tests, a low-HP capture pair at 960x540, clutch-drill hash parity and the full gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Low-health pulse proven after fixing the test-canvas stub: 255 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 17856 px pair, same clutch hash ae293bcd; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-80-lowhp-pulse' completed successfully.
[1/2] Enemies cycle: require warden slam LOS so cover blocks the hit, with a cover test, slam pair and warden_cover drill

impact_assessment.why: The warden slam applies damage on distance and vertical reach only; unlike the brute and wisp paths it never checks cover LOS, so a 30-damage slam lands through the 2 m north cover.
impact_assessment.benefits: Cover now reliably blocks the slam; the windup, ring, range, damage and cooldown are unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: warden damage gate only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: deterministic LOS only, no new tuning.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first cover-slam test, a staged cover pair, a warden_cover drill and the fairness/campaign suites.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Warden LOS proven: 257 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 123656 px cover pair, warden_cover hp 70->100, slam event intact; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-81-warden-los' completed successfully.
[1/2] Levels cycle: move the low platform 0.5 m east so the west wall gap is player-width, with a walk-through test, pair and west_gap drill

impact_assessment.why: The platform west face sits 0.5 m from the wall, narrower than the 0.7 m player, so the visible rear strip is an impassable dead end.
impact_assessment.benefits: A 1.0 m gap opens a real path around the platform's west side without changing its height or the jump.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: level layout/collider shift; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no new nodes; determinism and fairness need rechecking.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first walk-through test, a west-gap capture pair, a west_gap drill and the full jump/fairness suites.
